C0341.title: Henan Shangqiu: Organizing Ground Promoters to Guide Passersby in Assisting WeChat Registration for Criminal Use Leads to Sentencing
C0341.summary: Since spring 2020, Zhang and Li, knowing that upstream parties would use registered WeChat accounts for crime, still organized ground promotion teams to entice passersby with small gifts, guide them to scan codes, assist with registration, and provide the accounts upstream. The two made illegal gains of 156,274.21 yuan and returned 100,000 yuan. The Suiyang District People's Court of Shangqiu sentenced both to seven months in prison for aiding information network criminal activities and fined them 15,000 yuan and 10,000 yuan respectively.
